source.source_title: We Learn About the Telephone I
source.why_this_clip: A cartoon face seen in profile, drawn as a cross-section with the nose, lips and chin at the right; the lips open and close while sound waves spread out from the mouth. The clip dissolves from a plain profile into the cross-section around 1.0 to 1.5 s and cuts to a different man at 17.25 s, so 14.0 to 17.0 is the stretch with the most mouth movement and no cut.
